scope_change_reason: PR3878 leaves integer recovery in its physical caller open. Inspection found Mason Hale already supplies a complete dense CRT/integer reference, so reproducing that path would duplicate work. This result instead changes its recovery contract: a paid shorter exact residue product permits a rigorously lower Gaussian payload precision.
actual_scope: Universal modular interval lifting and carry-free packed residue convolution, plus a source-bound all-input Gaussian certificate and actual complete products at lower rounded precision.
bottleneck_link: The binding complex numerical route must eventually pay for precision and exact recovery. The new explicit interface trades numerical precision for one smaller exact product, rather than treating low residues or missing source-normalization factors as free.
